label: 📐 MATLAB
description: Read MATLAB .mat files. Supports both legacy (v4–v7, via scipy.io) and v7.3+ (HDF5-based, via h5py). Picks the first 2-D numeric variable by default — use the 'name' option to select a different variable. Requires the [science] extra.

name.label: Variable name
name.help: Which variable inside the .mat file to load. Default: the first 2-D numeric matrix found.
